add_library(cpp-cuda-exception)

if (HAVE_ROCM)
  if(${CMAKE_VERSION} VERSION_LESS "3.17.0")
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Build with HIP requires at least cmake 3.17.0")
  endif()

  enable_language(HIP)
  set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -D__HIP_PLATFORM_AMD__")

  find_package(HIP REQUIRED)
  target_include_directories(cpp-cuda-exception PRIVATE ${HIP_INCLUDE_DIRS})
endif()

if (HAVE_ROCM)
  # ROCm/HIP build: skip libcxxsupp (clang uses system libc++).
  target_link_libraries(cpp-cuda-exception PUBLIC
    contrib-libs-linux-headers
    yutil
    internal-platform-cuda
  )
else()
  # CUDA build: keep libcxxsupp.
  target_link_libraries(cpp-cuda-exception PUBLIC
    contrib-libs-linux-headers
    contrib-libs-cxxsupp
    yutil
    internal-platform-cuda
  )
endif()

target_sources(cpp-cuda-exception PRIVATE
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/library/cpp/cuda/exception/exception.cpp
)
